sentences.text: Mira, an 8-year-old spayed Domestic Shorthair, refused every Hill's z/d feeding from Jun 5 to 19, 30 in a row (34 of 38 rated feedings refused, 4 partly eaten), and the diet trial was stopped on day 19 of 42.
Intake not directly observed: a free-fed Purina ONE bowl was down, and what she ate from it is unknown.
Weight is −6.8% in 18 days, 4.4 kg Jun 1 to 4.1 kg Jun 19, on 2 home-scale readings.
In cats, 48 to 72 hours of markedly reduced intake is a hepatic-lipidosis risk window, and nothing is recorded after Jun 19.
Vomiting is logged on 5 of 19 logged days, with no medicines entered, not verified.
